name: ondata-extended
description: Modular MCP server platform: a backend-agnostic core with pluggable profiles (SKOS vocabularies, CKAN). Derived from ondata/ckan-mcp-server.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:worker-bundle && npm test
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ondata-extended/host-vocab && npm run build:worker -w @ondata-extended/host-vocab && npm run build -w @ondata-extended/host-ckan && npm run build:worker -w @ondata-extended/host-ckan && npm run build -w @ondata-extended/host-parliament && npm run build:worker -w @ondata-extended/host-parliament && npm run build -w @ondata-extended/host-example && npm run build:worker -w @ondata-extended/host-example
scripts.deploy:ckan: npm run build:worker -w @ondata-extended/host-ckan && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy -c packages/host-ckan/wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:parliament: npm run build:worker -w @ondata-extended/host-parliament && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy -c packages/host-parliament/wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:vocab: npm run build:worker -w @ondata-extended/host-vocab && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy -c packages/host-vocab/wrangler.toml
